title: Le calendrier des jours fastes et nefastes de l'annee egyptienne: traduction complete du papyrus Sallier IV
author: Francois Joseph Chabas
rights: Public domain (1870). Digitisation rights statement: https://rightsstatements.org/vocab/NoC-NC/1.0/ (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek).
holding_institution: Bayerische Staatsbibliothek (Munich), shelfmark digitised as bsb10997368

acquired_artifact.description: Full-volume OCR text assembled from the holding institution's open hOCR endpoint, one request per scan page, concatenated in scan order with an explicit page banner per page.
acquired_artifact.reproduction_note: Each page's hOCR ocr_line spans were stripped of markup, HTML-unescaped, whitespace-collapsed and joined with newlines under a '=== PAGE n (scan nnnnn) ===' banner.

layout_evidence.method: The same hOCR endpoint carries per-line bbox coordinates. Chabas sets the translation in three columns (day/Gregorian | mark | legend). Day cells were paired to their legend by vertical alignment: a day cell's baseline sits within ~30px of the first line of its own legend.
layout_evidence.independent_date_check: Where the day cell preserved its Gregorian equivalent, the Egyptian month/day was recomputed from Chabas' own Coptic anchor (1 Thoth = 11 September Gregorian, twelve 30-day months) and compared with the day number printed in the cell. Both routes agreed on every geometry-verified page.

known_ocr_limits.day_marks_not_machine_legible: Chabas reproduces the manuscript's three-part day mark in hieroglyphs rather than translating it. OCR renders these as noise ('000', 'キキ', '!!!'), so no per-day mark value is encoded from this artifact. The mark SYSTEM is encoded, because Chabas states it in running French prose (pp. 21-22).
known_ocr_limits.hieroglyphic_and_hieratic_footnotes: Footnote glyph citations are lost in OCR and are not relied on.
